title: Whittaker constructions for quantum affine algebras
summary: The goals of the paper are 3-fold. First, we revisit the construction of imaginary Whittaker modules over untwisted affine Kac-Moody Lie algebras. These modules are obtained using the parabolic induction from irreducible Whittaker modules over the associated Heisenberg Lie algebras. We show that the infinite support condition for Whittaker functions on Heisenberg Lie algebras is essential for irreducibility: when the support is finite the modules becomes reducible, yielding infinite chains of submodules.
